selection: Two Mondays preceding collection; UTC 00, 06, 12, 18. Fixed before downloading event bodies. No outcome-based selection.
privacy: Keep whole public archive only in ignored tmp cache; export allowlisted scalar metadata, field availability and raw-line hashes for matching repositories. No issue bodies, actor identities or email exports.
boundary: Events API records are not original Webhook deliveries. Missing records do not imply repository inactivity. No GitHub writes, forks, model calls or governance runs.
